title: 7 6sense Alternatives for 2026
summary: 6Sense flags companies whose web traffic and ads show buying intent. But what about contact-level data? Check out these 6sense alternatives.
body_markdown:
> Using 6sense today? Letterdrop works alongside it. See how they fit together:[Letterdrop and 6sense](https://letterdrop.com/compare/6sense) .


6Sense’s predictive models flag companies whose website traffic and ad clicks hint at buying intent.


This is helpful until you need to know *who* at these accounts is actually evaluating a vendor.


If you landed here, you’re clearly looking for an alternative that hands your team **contact-level intent.**


## What 6Sense *Really* Gives You


- **Account-level website & ad data.** “Anonymous” pageviews from reverse-IP lookup and ad impressions roll up into a predictive buying-stage score.
- **AI scoring dashboards.** Color-coded charts show which accounts are “Consideration,” “Decision,” or “Purchase.”
- **Heavy ABM stack.** Integrates with Marketo, Salesforce, and ad networks, but you still need separate tools for enrichment, content, and sequencing.
- **Enterprise pricing & lift.** Expect five-figure contracts, a multi-month implementation, and ops bandwidth to keep the engine humming.


Great if you’re a mature ABM org that already has enrichment, content, and outreach dialed in and just want to fine-tune account prioritization.


## #1 Letterdrop: Contacts at Accounts Evaluating Your Competitors


Best for GTM teams that need to know **which people** are evaluating competitor vendors and want them delivered to the tools reps already use.


| Letterdrop | 6sense | | Contact‑level names and titles at accounts in an active evaluation with your competitors, found through public sources like 10-Ks, RFPs, job posts, privacy policies, and subprocessor lists. | Account‑level reverse‑IP and ad data; users stay anonymous. | | A model backtested against real CRMs gives each account a confidence score and a recommended play. | AI stages accounts (Awareness → Purchase) but no buyer‑stage context for individuals. | | Delivers accounts and contacts daily to Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Clay, Apollo, Outreach, or AI agents via MCP. | Provides scores; users must build sequences in external tools. | | Names the likely buying committee at each account, matched to your CRM. | Requires separate enrichment providers for contact data. | | Flat tiers, generous contact caps, go‑live in days. | Enterprise contracts, multi‑month rollout, ongoing ops maintenance. | | 1‑click sync to HubSpot & Salesforce at the contact level. | Native account‑level pushes to Salesforce; contact sync depends on other tools. |


You get names, not logos, with Letterdrop


6sense is built for large ABM programs, so smaller teams may not use everything it offers.


[Joshua Breslin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joshuabreslin/) from PawaPay switched over to Letterdrop from 6sense.


> We’ve looked at things like 6Sense, but when you compare the value of like what we pay for Letterdrop versus what it would take to implement the likes of a 6Sense, it’s worlds apart. We believe that value is incredibly high. — Joshua Breslin


‎


## #2 Bombora: **Account-Level Surge Data for Classic ABM**


[Bombora](https://letterdrop.com/blog/bombora-alternative) ’s Company Surge® scores aggregate third-party content research into weekly account rankings.


Perfect if you already own enrichment and outbound tools and only need to know *which* companies are in-market this quarter, and like 6sense it works at the account level, so pair it with a way to find the people involved.


A report in Bombora


## #3 Demandbase One: Unified ABM, Advertising & Sales


A full “revenue OS” that merges **account targeting, B2B DSP, personalization and sales alerts.**


**Key Features**


- **AI-powered account insights** highlight the highest-value ICPs at every funnel stage.
- **Purpose-built B2B DSP** lets you run intent-based ads to specific roles inside target accounts.
- **Sales intelligence & automatic activity sync** pipe account activity straight into your CRM so reps see real-time buying signals.
- **Dynamic web personalization & journey analytics** measure how ads and onsite experiences move accounts toward revenue.


Demandbase One dashboard


## #4 RollWorks: Predictive Targeting & Multi-Channel Ads


Great if you want **look-alike account discovery and cross-channel orchestration** without 6sense’s enterprise price tag.


**Key Features**


- **Account discovery & predictive scoring** surface unknown ICP-look-alikes based on historical win patterns.
- **Journey Events & real-time alerts** tell you exactly when an account moves from awareness to decision.
- **Contact enrichment & CRM deanonymization** pull titles and phones so reps can act fast.
- **Multi-channel campaign builder** runs coordinated display, social and email plays from a single dashboard.


Rollworks dashboard


## #5 Clearbit: Real-Time Enrichment & Routing


Ideal for **marketing-ops teams** that need fresh contact data, scoring and routing the moment a new lead comes in.


Clearbit is growing more and more obselete, though.


**Key Features**


- **Form-shortening & enrichment** auto-fills firmographic + contact fields, boosting conversion while keeping data clean.
- **Buying-intent signals & lead scoring** help reps prioritize visitors who look ready to buy.
- **Copilot AI workspace** summarizes CRM records, preps sales call briefs and even spins up pipeline tasks.
- **Credit-pack pricing** (100–10 000 credits) lets smaller teams start for as little as ~$30/month.


Clearbit dashboard


## #6 Cognism: GDPR-Compliant Data x Bombora Intent


Cognism pairs phone-verified “Diamond Data®” contacts with Bombora intent so reps can call the **actual humans** showing interest, not just the logo.


**Key Features**


- **Phone-verified mobile numbers & Diamond Data®** deliver 87 % connect rates and eliminate hard-bounce headaches.
- **12 Bombora intent topics (plus 100 add-ons)** —more breadth than 6sense’s 10 default topics.
- **Sales Companion UI** with ChatGPT-style search for instant prospect lists.
- **Unrestricted export + instant CRM enrichment** at the contact level; no credit-based scarcity.
- **Full GDPR / CCPA compliance** and global data coverage (EMEA, NAM, APAC).


Cognism dashboard


## #7 ZoomInfo: Massive Database & Visitor-Tracking Intent


ZoomInfo layers one of the world’s largest B2B contact databases on top of website-visitor deanonymization and buyer-intent streams.


**Key Features**


- **Real-time account & contact profiles** (revenue, technographics, head-count, etc.) to power precise targeting.
- **Website Visitor Tracking & Form Optimization** turn anonymous traffic into named prospects.
- **Digital advertising + buyer-intent feeds** let Marketing retarget and Sales pounce the moment interest spikes.
- **Tiered packages by function** (Sales, Marketing, Talent) so teams can bolt on only the modules they need.


Zoominfo dashboard


## Final Thoughts


**Pick Letterdrop** if you want intent tied to real people **and** a turnkey workflow: prospects who are evaluating competitor vendors, a confidence score on each account, and a recommended play, delivered daily to the tools you already use, without gluing six tools together.


#### Ready to get contact-level data?


Letterdrop finds the accounts, and the contacts at them, actively evaluating your competitors.
